output_list.reason: Potential integer overflow vulnerability due to unchecked arithmetic operations.

Integer overflow vulnerability exists because the return value of a function call (which should be checked) is being used as the argument for arithmetic operations, leading to potential unhandled exceptions.
This vulnerability occurs when the return value of a function call is not being checked, resulting in potential loss of Ether due to malformed return values.
Arithmetic operations in contract balance may result in unexpected loss of Ether due to double withdrawals or other reasons causing the contract to not properly update its internal bookkeeping.
